title: Interruption Recovery Mechanism — Guided recovery from unexpected restarts
summary: Windows updates, power loss, and system crashes interrupt sessions mid-work. Framework should detect interruptions and offer recovery path: Resume / Inspect / Skip / New. Requires: track integrity check, autosave checkpoints, stale lug timeout detection, recovery prompt.
description: Session 73: User reported that Windows updates cause unexpected restarts, leaving work in-progress lugs and incomplete track entries. Current wakeup has no mechanism to: (1) detect if interruption happened, (2) offer resume path, (3) protect against data loss between last track entry and crash. Design: Track integrity validation + autosave checkpoints + timeout warnings + recovery prompt.
design_elements: Track Integrity Check: validate final entry has `completed: true` or all required fields
Interruption Detection: if last entry incomplete, flag as 'interrupted at Turn N'
Recovery Prompt: offer Green Light (resume) / Red Light (inspect) / Skip / New Project
Autosave Checkpoints: write turn state to `.autosave/turn-{N}.json` before appending to track
Track Corruption Recovery: if track.jsonl invalid but autosave exists, recover from checkpoint
In-Progress Lug Timeout: warn if in_progress lug unchanged >4h — suggest abandon/resume/extend
Session Status Marker: `_session_status` in WAI-State tracks interruption state (clean/interrupted/stale)
Cleanup: autosave files 3+ sessions old deleted at closeout
benefits: Zero work lost: autosave + track validation = complete state recovery
User-guided recovery: 'Resume?' prompt prevents confusion about stale in_progress lugs
Transparency: briefing clearly shows interruption status
Resilience: works after power loss, OS crash, unexpected restart
next_action: Implement epic-interruption-recovery-v1 (framework-wide). Affects wakeup + closeout + track schema.
learning: Session continuity isn't just about memory (lugs/tracks). It's also about detecting when continuity was broken and offering repair paths. Framework should assume interruptions are normal, not edge cases.
routing_notes: High-impact learning for all spokes. Teaches that recovery mechanisms are essential for real-world interruptions.
